editorial:
Imagine being stuck on a plane that is suddenly taken over by armed hijackers. That is exactly how your ride starts in this tense story. You get to see the chaos from a few different sides: the terrified passengers, the hijackers with their own political goals, and the government officials trying to figure out a plan. The vibe is very stressed and heavy, making you feel like you are right there in the terminal with the hostages. It does a great job showing how scary it is when you are completely trapped in a foreign country with no way out.

The acting is solid and keeps you hooked even when the movie slows down for political talks. While some parts feel a bit long, the final rescue mission is a huge rush and really pays off. If you like true stories based on real events, you will love this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick watch. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move because the action scenes look great.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a super daring rescue mission by Israeli soldiers who fly in secret. They land at night, dress up like the local airport staff to trick the guards, and storm the terminal. They quickly take down the hijackers and save almost all the hostages. Most of the passengers get to go home safely, while the movie wraps up by showing the real-life photos of the people involved in the event.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime or historical rescue stories.
